description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rate of exchange with effect from 16.03.2020 to 22.03.2020
categorisation: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for financial/commercial transactions at customs, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter. While it names the Director General of Customs, this is only to establish the authority issuing the regulation, not to announce a personnel change or assign detailed portfolio responsibilities. The core content is regulatory in nature, establishing legally binding exchange rates for customs purposes.
